g.text: UML sequence - readiness-gated statement, single-use retrieval, correction and permitted disposal
lock account FOR SHARE (wait for in-flight posters)
readiness: month ended in Core UTC clock;
enrolled policies finalized through month end
version n+1 supersedes n (INITIAL / LINKED_CORRECTION / SOURCE_CHANGED)
metadata + object + evidence in one transaction
link -> random token, digest stored, 2 minutes
redeem: same actor, unused, unexpired, current owner, object digest
